name: Dawson County, NE
findings: Dawson County has 80 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dawson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Dawson County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
